name: Kharis Sector
narrative_role: Formerly prosperous Union sector affected by approximately a decade of organized-criminal entrenchment, fragmented enforcement, and declining practical access to central institutions.
description: The sector encompassing the Lethan system and Kallis Foundry, through which the Shadow Fleet operated without coherent detection during the Dark Star Incident.
reconciliation_note: Reconciled 2026-07-21 from committed Dark Star arc canon (narrative v1.1 + AAR + event_dark_star_incident). Derivation from established canon, additive; prior fields preserved.
